title: Schedule for Friday August 7, 2026
body:
The Senate
stands adjourned until 10:00am on Friday, August 7, 2026.

Following
Leader remarks, the Senate will proceed to Executive Session and resume
consideration of the 74 nominations en bloc as provided for in Executive
Calendar #6, S.Res.817, post-cloture.

At 11:30am
the Senate will proceed to Legislative Session for the consideration of
H.R.5334, vehicle for Sanctions legislation. The only amendments in order
to be offered by their sponsor or their designee will be Graham-Blumenthal
#6711, Graham #6712 (title amendment) and Paul #6715.

There will be
up to 2 minutes of debate prior to a vote on the Paul amendment #6715, if
offered. Upon disposition of the Paul amendment, the Graham-Blumenthal
#6711, as amended, if amended, will be agreed to, there will be 5 minutes under
the control of Senator Graham and upon the use or yielding back of that time
the Senate vote on passage of the bill, as amended with 60 affirmative votes
required for passage. If passed, the Graham amendment to the title #6712
will be agreed to, and the title, as amended, will be agreed to.

Upon
disposition of H.R.5334 the Senate will resume Executive Session and vote on
confirmation of the 74 nominations en bloc as provided for in Executive
Calendar #6, S.Res.817.

Upon
disposition of the nominations en bloc the Senate will vote on the motion to

title: Schedule for Tuesday, July 28, 2026
body:
The Senate
stands adjourned until 5:00pm on Tuesday, July 28, 2026.

On Tuesday,
July 28, at 10:00am, a ceremony commemorating the life and legacy of the late
Senator Lindsey O. Graham will be held in the Rotunda of the United States
Capitol. The ceremony is open to Members of Congress, invited
other members of the government, and Senator Graham’s family and friends by
invitation only. Senators are requested
to assemble in the Senate Chamber at 9:30am and proceed to the Rotunda at
9:45am. There will not be seating in the Rotunda, Senators should
expect to be standing for the full ceremony.

Following the
Congressional Tribute to the Honorable Lindsey O. Graham, there will be a
funeral service at the Washington National Cathedral at 2:00pm. Buses will
board at 12:30pm and depart at 12:40pm.

When the Senate
convenes at 5:00pm, following Leader remarks, the Senate will proceed to
Executive Session and resume consideration of Executive Calendar #833, Walter
Clayton, of New York, to be Director of National Intelligence, post-cloture.

At
approximately 6:30pm, the Senate will vote on confirmation of the Clayton
nomination.

Upon
